name: Hensel Deckel-DK-01xx enclosure lid
summary: Deckel-DK-01xx enclosure lid arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: Deckel-DK-01xx is the drawing identifier for enclosure lid in Hensel's ENYCASE enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An enclosure lid closes the selected enclosure base. Its removal or opening space, fixings and any attached equipment need to be coordinated separately from the base.

For example, in a junction-box installation where technicians need access to internal terminals, use the Deckel-DK-01xx reference to coordinate lid fixings, opening or removal space and attached equipment. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYCASE_DK_Deckel/Deckel-DK-01xx.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
